### Core Findings & Audit Verdict

**Definitive Outcome:**  
**No viable official alternative release source exists** that provides member-level downloadable genome assemblies or a faster exact archive mirror for the published SMAG 40,039 catalogue. **Zenodo Record 8223844 remains the sole authoritative, complete, and reproducible public release** for the published assemblies and our fixed 1,500 random sample.

1. **NCBI GenBank ([PRJNA983538](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/PRJNA983538)) is Fatal to H3 Design (55.53% Missing):**
   - NCBI hosts only **16,530 assemblies** (`GCA_036704125.1`–`GCA_036937395.1`), corresponding exclusively to the *unknown* Species-level Genome Bins (uSGB representatives). It omits all 4,547 known species SGBs and all 18,963 redundant cluster members.
   - For our pre-specified 1,500 random sample ([`sampled_smag_1500_ids_seed20261014.txt`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round7_analyses/h3_references/results/sampled_smag_1500_ids_seed20261014.txt)), **exactly 833 genomes (55.53%) are completely absent from NCBI**. Only 667 genomes (44.47%) are present.
   - NCBI BioSample isolate IDs use `SMAG_U*` without a public mapping table to the published 40,039 `user_genome` IDs (`BL1bin.1`, etc.).
   - Conditioning on NCBI would introduce severe novelty selection bias and violate the pre-registered uniform sampling design.

2. **CyVerse Data Store is Blocked & Monolithic:**
   - Anonymous WebDAV access (`https://data.cyverse.org/dav-anon/iplant/home/lucyzju/Caiyu_SMAG_catalog_2023/MAG.tar.gz`) returns an HTTP 307 redirect to `https://unblockme.cyverse.org/` (interactive anti-bot challenge), failing automated retrieval from local machines and IBEX nodes.
   - Even if unblocked, CyVerse hosts only a single monolithic ~36–39 GB `.tar.gz` archive, not member-level assemblies.

3. **Author Web Server & Cloud Mirrors are Decommissioned:**
   - Author web interface (`https://smag.microbmalab.cn`) fails DNS resolution. The authors' GitHub README and project page officially confirm the domain was retired due to maintenance costs and advise using Zenodo.
   - AWS China S3 mirror (`bma-smag.s3.cn-northwest-1.amazonaws.com.cn`) returns HTTP 404 Not Found.

4. **ENA and NGDC / CNCB:**
   - ENA only mirrors the raw SRA read runs under PRJNA983538 (no genome assemblies).
   - NGDC (China) hosts no independent assembly release; the Beijing Institute of Genomics community guide (*Awesome MAG* by Dr. Rui Li) explicitly directs users to Zenodo 8223844.

| **Zenodo (Record 8223844)** | REST API / Direct HTTPS (373 parts, 39.02 GB) | No (tar stream) | **1,500 / 1,500 (100.0%)** | **Active & Authoritative** (Sole valid source) |
| **NCBI GenBank (PRJNA983538)** | E-utilities / FTP (`GCA_*`) | Yes | **667 / 1,500 (44.47%)** | **Ineligible** (833 / 55.53% missing; uSGB subset only) |
| **CyVerse Data Store** | WebDAV (`MAG.tar.gz`) | No (monolithic) | Unknown | **Blocked** (HTTP 307 to `unblockme.cyverse.org`) |
| **Microbma Web Portal** | `smag.microbmalab.cn` | Previously | Unknown | **Decommissioned** (DNS failure; authors retired domain) |
| **AWS China S3** | `cn-northwest-1` S3 bucket | No (monolithic) | 0.0% | **Offline** (HTTP 404 Not Found) |
| **ENA** | EBI filereport API | No | 0.0% | **No Assemblies** (SRA raw reads only) |
| **NGDC / CNCB** | GSA / GWH / Awesome MAG | No | Points to Zenodo | **No Direct Hosting** (Points to Zenodo 8223844) |
